profile: Rust FFI for Apple and Android
prompt: Evolve a Rust callback API consumed by Swift and Kotlin while preserving compatibility.

work_units.protected_behavior: Required cross-language specialist routes are selected before boundary design.

facets.action: select and record the Rust-Swift FFI specialist route before boundary design
select and record the Rust-Kotlin FFI specialist route before boundary design
select and record the independent FFI review route as an admission decision, not as an executed review

work_units.protected_behavior: Boundary design is grounded in a complete cross-language inventory or an explicit context gap.

facets.action: inventory the current Rust exports before boundary design or record the repository context gap
inventory the generated Swift bindings before boundary design or record the repository context gap
inventory the generated Kotlin bindings before boundary design or record the repository context gap
inventory the handwritten Swift consumers before boundary design or record the repository context gap
inventory the handwritten Kotlin consumers before boundary design or record the repository context gap
inventory the native package artifacts before boundary design or record the repository context gap
inventory the supported consumer and core versions before boundary design or record the repository context gap
inventory the deployed consumer and core versions before boundary design or record the repository context gap
inventory the native loading paths before boundary design or record the repository context gap

work_units.protected_behavior: The versioned ABI representation remains stable and unambiguous across consumers. Every transferred value has symmetric allocator ownership and release behavior. Typed failures and language exceptions remain contained at every FFI boundary.

facets.action: define the ABI versioning contract
define the ABI layout contract
define the allocator that owns every transferred value
define the matching release API for every transferred value
define nullability behavior at every boundary
define the cross-language encoding contract
define the typed error representation at the C ABI
define Swift typed-error mapping
define Kotlin typed-error mapping
contain Rust panics and foreign exceptions at every FFI boundary

work_units.protected_behavior: Callback ownership reaches observable quiescence before foreign state is released.

facets.action: define callback state ownership
define thread or actor affinity for callback delivery
define callback reentrancy behavior
define cancellation ownership
define rejection of callbacks delivered after cancellation
define rejection of callbacks owned by a stale runtime generation
define callback drain and join ordering
define the observable callback-quiescence condition

work_units.protected_behavior: Supported old and new consumers can coexist, migrate, and roll back safely.

facets.action: define old and new consumer coexistence
define the consumer and core migration sequence
define the rollback path
define symbol compatibility across supported versions
define evidence-based removal conditions for old ABI surfaces

work_units.protected_behavior: Rust, Swift, and Kotlin language-level boundary behavior has explicit evidence. Generated Swift and Kotlin bindings have explicit compatibility evidence. The required old/new consumer and core compatibility matrix has explicit evidence.

facets.action: plan Rust boundary evidence
plan Swift boundary evidence
plan Kotlin boundary evidence
plan generated Swift binding evidence
plan generated Kotlin binding evidence
plan old Swift consumer with new core evidence
plan old Kotlin consumer with new core evidence
plan new Swift consumer with old core evidence
plan new Kotlin consumer with old core evidence

work_units.protected_behavior: Cancellation and callback quiescence have deterministic lifecycle evidence.

facets.action: plan deterministic cancellation evidence
plan deterministic callback-quiescence evidence

work_units.protected_behavior: Post-change FFI review remains evidence-gated and covers every material consumer and risk axis.

facets.action: require an approved diff before post-change FFI review; otherwise record NOT RUN and the missing diff
require generated artifacts before post-change FFI review; otherwise record NOT RUN and the missing artifacts
require a changed-file list before post-change FFI review; otherwise record NOT RUN and the missing list
require raw verification evidence before post-change FFI review; otherwise record NOT RUN and the missing evidence
when review evidence is admitted, independently review the Swift consumer path; otherwise keep this review NOT RUN
when review evidence is admitted, independently review the Kotlin consumer path; otherwise keep this review NOT RUN
when review evidence is admitted, independently review ABI risks; otherwise keep this review NOT RUN
when review evidence is admitted, independently review callback lifecycle risks; otherwise keep this review NOT RUN
when review evidence is admitted, independently review packaging risks; otherwise keep this review NOT RUN
when review evidence is admitted, independently review mixed-version risks; otherwise keep this review NOT RUN
when review evidence is admitted, independently review rollback risks; otherwise keep this review NOT RUN

forbidden_actions: treat generated bindings as inherently correct
change the ABI without migration and rollback design
